The '''''Auditor''''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] assigned to the planet [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It attempted to stop the ''[[Black Obsession]]'' as it smuggled political prisoners off world.
